business_summary: Guangdong SACA Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, design, and sale of consumer electronic products in China and internationally. The company offers a double wall drawer; concealed slide; ball bearing slide; euro slide, including metal box, bottom mounted drawer, and soft closing epoxy drawer; lifting systems; hinge; damping systems; kitchen basket; sink/faucet, wardrobe hardware, and connecting hardware. It also provides power supplies, including mobile power supplies, wall chargers, car starters, and car chargers; baby lights, vacuum cleaners, milk frothers, fans, and air fryers; jewelry storage baskets; computer and mobile phone peripherals such as baby monitors, laser TVs and projectors; furniture, comprising heating pads, inflatable mattresses, storage stools, and coffee tables. The company serves furniture, household and home appliances, tool cabinets, bathrooms, automobiles and other industries. It sells its consumer electronics products through online platforms. The company also exports its products to Europe, North America, Japan, and the Middle East. Guangdong SACA Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Foshan, China.
